observations.behavior: Adds a check for object-level access controls before resource-level checks, returning NO_ACCESS_LEVEL immediately if the object row is NO_ACCESS_LEVEL.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a resource-level grant from widening an object-level denial, potentially changing access results for private objects.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test class and tests, including a private dashboard, resource grants, and checks for retrieval and listing behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: This could demonstrate that the access control implementation correctly denies access to private objects even when a broader resource grant exists.

observations.behavior: Changes the oracle implementation to check object rows and return NO_ACCESS_LEVEL if the object default is NO_ACCESS_LEVEL, before checking resource rows.
observations.posthog_connection: This could change the expected behavior of the access control implementation, potentially changing access results for private objects.
